detail.empty_issues_hint: You can also add existing issues to this project.

resources.local_daemon_offline_hint: Start the local daemon to attach a directory on this machine.
resources.local_daemon_already_attached_hint: This machine already has a local directory attached. Remove it before adding another.
resources.local_no_daemon_tooltip: Local daemon isn't reporting an ID yet — the agent can't open this directory.
resources.local_other_machine_tooltip: Only available on the machine that registered this directory.
resources.chat_hint_worktree_prefix: Agent will work in an isolated worktree of
resources.chat_hint_worktree_note: Your working copy stays untouched — each run hands its work back as an agent/… branch.
resources.toast_local_already_attached: This directory is already attached to the project on this machine.
resources.toast_local_daemon_already_attached: This machine already has a local directory attached to this project. Remove it before adding another.
resources.local_validate_unsupported: Local directories can only be picked on the desktop app.
resources.mode_dialog_title: How should runs use this folder?
resources.mode_dialog_description: This decides how you get an agent's work back, and whether runs on this folder can execute at the same time.
resources.mode_in_place_description: One run at a time. Changes appear in your working copy as the agent makes them, ready for you to keep working on.
resources.mode_worktree_description: Runs execute at the same time without touching your working copy. Each one hands back an agent/… branch in this repo for you to review and merge.
resources.mode_worktree_needs_git: This folder is not a git repository, so there is nowhere to put the branch. Pick a repository, or keep editing the folder directly.
resources.mode_worktree_needs_server_upgrade: Your Multica server is too old to execute runs in parallel — it would quietly execute them in this folder instead. Update the server, then switch this on.
resources.mode_edit_tooltip: Change how runs use this folder
resources.mode_badge_worktree_tooltip: Runs execute at the same time in their own git worktree and hand back a branch. Your working copy is untouched.
resources.toast_local_mode_update_failed: Could not update the execution mode
resources.ref_hint: Tasks start from this branch and open their pull requests against it. Leave empty to use the repository's default branch.
resources.ref_error_characters: A git ref can't contain spaces or any of ~ ^ : ? * [ \
resources.ref_error_format: Not a valid branch, tag, or commit.
resources.ref_dialog_title: Which branch should tasks work on?
resources.ref_dialog_description: New tasks in this project check out this branch and open their pull requests against it. Work already underway keeps the branch it started on.
resources.ref_edit_tooltip: Change the branch tasks work on
resources.ref_badge_tooltip: Tasks start from {{ref}} and deliver back to it.
resources.ref_error_commit: That's a commit, not a branch. Tasks deliver back to the branch they start from — for a one-off revision, pass --ref to multica repo checkout.
resources.ref_default_tooltip: No branch set — tasks use whatever the repository's default branch is at the time.

delete_dialog.title: Delete project
delete_dialog.description: This will delete the project. Issues will not be deleted but will be unlinked.

permissions.title: Project permissions
permissions.dialog_description: Grant access to people, departments, or everyone. Project access also affects tasks inside this project.
permissions.add_members_description: Choose people, departments, or everyone, then select their project role.
permissions.no_results: No workspace members match your search
permissions.role_owner_description: Can manage the project, tasks, members, and project settings.
permissions.role_manager_description: Can manage the project and tasks, but not members or project settings.
permissions.role_member_description: Can view and work on tasks in the project.
permissions.role_viewer_description: Can only view the project and its tasks.
permissions.grant_failed: Some members could not be updated. Try again.
permissions.task_permissions_description: Copy the link to send this task. Add access here when someone needs permission.
permissions.task_link_copy_failed: Could not copy the link. Copy it manually.
permissions.add_task_access_description: Choose people and departments, then select what they can do on this task.
permissions.existing_task_access_description: Manage this task's manual grants, and see who else has access through a mention, assignment or similar.
permissions.derived_access_note: Access from a mention can be withdrawn here; it comes back only if the person is mentioned again. Creator and assignee access comes from the task itself.
permissions.task_mention_revoked: Withdrew the access that mention granted
permissions.task_mention_revoke_failed: Could not withdraw that access. Try again.
permissions.task_authorization_subject_required: Select or enter an authorization subject
permissions.task_access_summary_description: A quick summary of what you can do on this task.
permissions.task_policy_project_task: This task inherits access from its project · Policy version {{version}}
permissions.task_policy_projectless_task: Projectless tasks use direct grants only · Policy version {{version}}
permissions.task_select_subjects_first: Select people, departments, or everyone first
permissions.task_permissions_readonly_manage: You can view your access sources, but only someone with Manage task permission can change sharing.
permissions.project_access_readonly: You do not have permission to manage this project, so you cannot grant access here. Ask a project owner to change it.
permissions.project_access_load_failed: Could not load this project's access settings. Try again.
permissions.task_permissions_load_failed: Could not load this task's access settings, so we cannot tell whether you may manage them.
permissions.task_save_failed: Task permissions were not saved. Your edits remain available to retry.
permissions.task_changed_reload: Permissions changed elsewhere. Latest policy reloaded; review and try again.
permissions.task_request_review_failed: The request could not be reviewed. Refresh and try again.
permissions.task_request_focus_hint: Opened from the inbox and focused on this request.
